name: Frankie's
notes: Cocktail bar/lounge menu (Squarespace built-in Menu block) at /menu. "Summer '26" (8 cocktails) and "House Classics" (7 cocktails) sections carry a single flat per-tab price ($15 and $16 respectively) in the tab header rather than per-item, applied to every item in that section. Wine section lists glass/bottle price pairs (kept the glass price as the filed price, bottle price noted separately). Beer section prices are bare numbers with no "$" markup at all (e.g. "8" = $8), parsed from the item description field. Dropped the "Happy Hour" tab (9 cocktails) entirely - genuinely no price shown anywhere on the page for that section, just names/ingredients ("Rotating Slushie - Inquire with Bartender"). Food is limited to 2 small-bites items (Mixed Nuts, Kettle Chips); this is a bar-forward venue, no separate dinner/food menu was found on the site.
